battle.name: 杜揚州
battle.brief: 大業十二年，隋煬帝再發大軍討林邑，主將劉方圍都城毗驩數月，國相昆吾詐降反攻，隋軍大敗，主將中箭卒於軍中，諸軍無功而還；隋朝仍於故地置杜揚州，續以羈縻。羅馬方陣盾不在此役，但隋軍步卒結盾拒象、以車壁代盾牆，正是「盾緣咬住盾緣」那套道理。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方是隋朝與林邑國，即占人所建、盤據今越南中部海岸的占婆王國。隋朝一方在大業十二年正月下詔，以虎賁郎將劉方為行軍總管，率兵討林邑，陳稟等為副將；行軍總管之下設行軍長史、軍曹參軍分軍部署，舟師與步騎分道而進，會於海口一線。後方以新附的交州、驩州、欽州為屯糧與徵發之地，俚人部伍、南征宿軍與配役罪人充當兵源，糧秣兼由海運轉輸。林邑一方以王庭為核心，國王梵志居毗驩，國相昆吾掌政，外官分為二百餘部，長官稱弗羅、次稱可輪；其軍事主力是披甲巨象，輔以弓、箭、刀、槊與竹製毒弩，城防則以磚築城、蜃灰塗壁，都城象林與大占海口皆如此。周邊格局上，真臘為林邑西南的舊屬國，與林邑時有爭端，交州俚人與隋軍的關係亦遠非一心，隋軍南進等於在一片不穩的邊地作戰。
countriesEn: The belligerents in this war were the Sui dynasty and Lâm Ấp, the Cham kingdom that occupied the central coast of what is now Vietnam. On the Sui side the order was issued in the first month of the twelfth year of Daye, with the tiger-guard commander Liu Fang appointed overall commander of the expedition and Chen Bin and others as his lieutenants; beneath the overall commander sat a military registrar and a staff of army registrars who divided the force into columns, the naval squadron and the infantry and cavalry moving by separate roads and joining along the line of the river mouth. Behind them lay the newly subordinated prefectures of Jiaozhou, Xuanzhou and Qin Prefecture as depots for grain and as sources of conscripted troops, with the southern clans, the veterans of the earlier southern campaigns and men condemned to service filling the ranks, while grain came both by sea and by land. On the Lâm Ấp side the state was organised around the royal court: the king Fan Zhi sat at Viadhapura, the minister Kun Wu took charge of affairs, the external districts were divided into more than two hundred units whose chiefs were titled Pho Lo or Kho Luan, and the core of the military strength was the armoured elephant, supported by bows, arrows, sabres, spears and bamboo crossbows with poisoned bolts. The cities were built in brick and plastered with shell lime, both the capital Xiang Lin and the great harbour town of Da Zhan Haikou being so built. In the wider region Zhèn Là, an old dependency lying to the south-west, was in constant rivalry with Lâm Ấp, and the tribes of Jiaozhou were far from wholeheartedly Sui, so the Sui army was fighting in a borderland that was never firmly held.
people: 真正決定此役走向的是四個人。隋煬帝楊廣在大業十二年下詔出兵，此時他已三次征高麗而大敗，正需要一場南方勝利來洗刷聲威；詔令發出時他正在北方巡行，糧秣、馬匹與行政樞紐都已在路上，這場戰爭的規模與時機由他一人決定。主將劉方此前平定交州、又兩度擊林邑，熟悉南方山地與海路，是最合適的人選；他率軍自交州南下，糧盡疫生，士卒死者甚眾，仍推進到毗驩城下，把王城圍了數月，最後中箭卒於軍中，一支大軍的指揮核心就這樣塌掉。另一端的國相昆吾是林邑這一方的主角：城中食盡、援兵不來之際，他遣使請降，等隋軍入城才反戈，奪門縱火，擊潰正在展開的隋軍，扭轉了全局。國王梵志在城破前已退入海中，復國之後遣使請罪、朝貢不絕，反而保住了國祚。隋軍還朝之後，煬帝震怒，諸將多被下獄治罪，此役的敗績也就成了隋廷內部崩解的一個節點。
peopleEn: Four men decided how this war went. Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, issued the order in the twelfth year of Daye; by then he had been beaten three times at Koguryŏ and needed a victory in the south to redeem his reputation, and the order was written while he was on tour in the north with grain, horses and the administrative machinery already on the road, so the scale and the timing of the campaign were his decision alone. Liu Fang, the commander, had already pacified Jiaozhou and struck Lâm Ấp twice, knew the southern mountains and the sea routes better than anyone, and was the obvious choice. He marched south from Jiaozhou, and when grain ran out and sickness broke out, with many of his men dead, he still pushed on to the walls of Viadhapura, held the capital in siege for several months, and was finally killed by a shaft in the camp, and with him the command core of a great army simply collapsed. On the other side the decisive figure was the minister Kun Wu: with the city emptied of food and no relief coming, he sent an envoy to offer surrender, waited until the Sui troops had entered the city, and then turned his weapons, seized the gates and set fires, scattering the Sui as they were still deploying, and reversed the situation. The king Fan Zhi had already gone to sea before the city fell, and after the restoration he sent an embassy to apologise and paid tribute without interruption, which preserved the state. When the survivors returned to court the emperor was furious, several of the generals were thrown into prison and punished, and the defeat became one of the joints in the coming disintegration of the Sui court.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬方陣盾，學名 Scutum，是公元前一世紀羅馬步兵的標準防具：凸面的長方盾，高約一米、寬約半米，重約七至九公斤，中央有盾臍，握把與邊緣都磨得發亮；羅馬人列陣時讓盾緣與盾緣互相咬住，一整排加上一整排便成了一道連續的盾牆，後方的標槍手在掩體後投矛，前排盾手再以短劍格擋。本役現場沒有羅馬盾，這一點必須講清楚：《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都沒有記載隋朝或林邑使用過羅馬式方盾。隋軍步卒所恃的是本地盾——皮盾、木盾與供弩手遮蔽的大盾，盾牌之間不靠咬合，而靠隊形與旗幟維持；更要緊的是隋軍把輜重車圍成環形的車壁，用來抵擋巨象的撞擊，等於用車牆代替盾牆。林邑的投射武器是竹製弩機與淬毒箭矢，近距離用刀、槊與標槍，象背上是實際的突擊主力，城外還布有木柵、陷坑與毒水。若把兩種做法放在一起比，羅馬方陣盾的道理在於「整體咬合」，而隋軍在這場戰役裡缺的正是整體：進攻縱隊拉得太長、糧道拉得太遠，一旦前段被突襲，盾陣與車壁便各自為政。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scutum, the standard piece of infantry protection in the first century BC: a convex rectangular shield about a metre high and half a metre across, weighing some seven to nine kilograms, with a boss in the centre, its grip and rim worn bright by use. When the Romans deployed they made the rims of the shields lock into the rims of their neighbours, so that one rank behind another formed a continuous wall, the pilum men throwing their javelins from behind that cover while the shield men in front met the enemy with the short sword. There was no Roman shield on the field of this campaign, and that has to be said plainly: neither the History of Sui nor the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance records the Sui or the Cham using a Roman-type rectangular shield. What the Sui foot soldiers relied on were local shields, hide and wooden ones and the large shields carried by crossbowmen for cover; their shields did not lock into one another but were held in place by formation and by the flags. More important still, the Sui drew up their baggage waggons into a ring of wains to serve as a car-wall against the charge of the elephants, which was the car-wall standing in for the shield-wall. The Cham missile weapons were bamboo bow frames and poisoned arrows, with sabres, spears and javelins for the close work, the real weight of their assault resting on the beasts' backs, while outside the walls they had laid stockades, pits and poisoned water. Set the two systems side by side and the point of the Roman scutum is that the strength lies in the interlocking of the whole, and what the Sui army lacked in this campaign was precisely the whole: the attacking column was stretched too long and the supply line drawn too far, and once the leading part was surprised the shield line and the wain ring fell apart.
tactics: 隋軍的打法是分進合擊加長期圍城。舟師沿比景、海陰一線南下，步騎自交州、越裳一線陸行，兩路在海口與林邑國境會合；先以小股兵力掃掉林邑前哨與沿線關隘，再推進到國都毗驩城下。圍城之後是教科書式的攻城流程：築土山、填壕溝、列弩環攻，把隨軍帶來的弩與矢一批批送上城頭，同時靠海路與交州屯糧維持度日。林邑的應對是先以巨象與竹弩在城外消耗，再把城牆、毒水與陷坑留給攻城者；最後的轉折來自一次詐降：國相昆吾在城內食盡、援兵不至的時候遣使請降，隋軍部分人馬入城受降，昆吾隨即反戈，奪門縱火，衝散正在展開的隋軍，潰兵又在城外遭象群踩踏與毒箭追射，攻守就此易位。這套打法說明一件事：盾牆式的防禦靠的是整體咬合與節奏一致，一旦被從內部打亂或從側翼繞過，盾與車都救不了陣形；隋軍的失敗不在於缺乏結陣的工具，而在於深入之後的補給與指揮。
tacticsEn: The Sui method was convergence followed by a long siege. The naval squadron worked south along the line of Bi Cang and Hai Yin while the infantry and cavalry came overland through Jiaozhou and Yue Shang, the two columns joining on the Lâm Ấp frontier; small detachments first swept away the Cham outposts and the passes along the route, and the army then pressed on to the capital at Viadhapura. What followed was the textbook sequence of siege: earthen ramps raised against the walls, the ditch filled, crossbows massed in a ring around the city, the bolts carried up to the ramparts in batches from the stores carried by the army, while the sea route and the depots of Jiaozhou kept the besiegers supplied. The Cham answered by wearing the Sui down outside with elephants and bamboo crossbows, and then left the walls, the poisoned water and the pits to the besiegers. The turning point came from a feigned surrender: with the city out of food and no relief in sight, the minister Kun Wu sent an envoy to surrender, part of the Sui force entered the city to accept it, and Kun Wu at once turned his weapons, seized the gates and set fire, scattering the Sui as they were still forming up; the broken troops were then trampled by the elephants and pursued by poisoned arrows outside the walls, and attack and defence changed places. The method says one thing plainly: a defence of the shield-wall kind depends on the interlocking of the whole and on a common tempo, and once it is broken from within or turned from the flank, neither shields nor wains can save the formation. The Sui did not fail for want of a means of forming up, but for want of supply and of command once they had gone deep.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。兵力：《資治通鑑》記隋軍以「率兵十萬餘」出師，這是出征時宣稱的總數，實際能作戰與護糧的比例遠低於此。時間：大業十二年正月或二月下詔出兵，軍隊自交州南下，抵達毗驩後圍城數月，至年底班師返京，前後約一年。距離：自交州、驩州一線至林邑都城，要走數百里的沿海山地與林莽地，行程本身就是最大的消耗。損失：史書只作「士卒死者甚眾」「疾病死者相屬」一類的概括記載，並無可以坐實的精確數目；主將劉方中箭卒於軍中，是本役最確切的損失記錄。城防：林邑各城以磚築、蜃灰塗壁，都城與大占海口皆然；國相昆吾的詐降也說明城牆本身足夠結實，問題出在人心與糧食。制度數字：林邑外官分二百餘部；隋朝此役之後仍在其地置杜揚州，以驩州為治；唐武德五年廢杜揚州，改置驩州。前情：自隋文帝開皇年間起，隋朝對林邑出兵不止一次，大業初年一役破其國都而還，大業十二年再戰則全軍失利，前後得失之別正在補給與攻城器械。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. Strength: the Comprehensive Mirror records that the Sui army went out with a proclaimed force of more than a hundred thousand men, which is the total claimed for the expedition, and the proportion that could actually be put into combat and into guarding the grain was far lower. Timing: the order was issued in the first or second month of the twelfth year of Daye, the army came south from Jiaozhou, reached Viadhapura, spent several months in the siege, and returned to the capital at the end of the year, the whole business taking roughly a year. Distance: from the line of Jiaozhou and Xuanzhou to the Cham capital lay several hundred li of coastal mountain and forest, and the march itself was the largest single drain on the army. Losses: the histories compress this into phrases such as very many of the soldiers were killed and the deaths from sickness came one after another, and no figure can be confirmed; the most exact loss recorded is the death of the commander Liu Fang, struck down in the camp. Fortifications: the Cham cities were built in brick and plastered with shell lime, the capital and the great harbour town alike, and the fact that the minister could offer a surrender at all shows that the walls themselves were strong enough and that the trouble lay in men and grain. Institutional figures: Lâm Ấp had more than two hundred external districts; after this campaign the Sui still set up Duyang Zhou in the old territory, with Xuanzhou as its seat; and in the fifth year of Wude the Tang abolished Duyang Zhou and set up Xuanzhou in its place. Background: from the Kaihuang years of Emperor Wen the Sui had campaigned against Lâm Ấp more than once; the campaign at the beginning of Daye took the capital and returned, and the one in the twelfth year of Daye ended in ruin, and the difference between the two lies in supply and in siege equipment.
cause: 打起上來的緣由有三層。最外一層是朝貢與邊界的僵持：林邑自隋文帝朝起與中原保持往來，國王梵志既不克定期入朝，也不肯放棄在越裳一帶的既得利益，兩國的名分與地界都懸而未決，隋軍南下等於逼對方表態。第二層是隋朝在南海的整體政策：宮廷裡「群臣言林邑多奇寶」的風氣一直存在，隋朝已置比景、海陰二縣，也派屯田主事常駿浮海使赤土，把林邑故地視為可經略的屬地；而大業年間三次征高麗皆大敗，煬帝需要一場南方勝利來重整聲威。第三層是軍事技術的成熟：交州、驩州已平，可以徵發兵糧、徵集俚人部伍，舟師與海運技術自南朝以來已可用，隋廷自以為有把握。真正的漏洞也正在這裡：大業年間的東都、運河、長城與連年北征已把國力耗到極處，一支十萬人的遠征軍要靠海路運糧、要靠熱帶山地的補給鏈維持，而隋朝已沒有多餘的民力承受這種消耗。於是這場戰爭從一開始就不只是外交問題，而是一個王朝用最後的體力去賭的一次豪舉。
causeEn: There are three layers to the reason the war came about. The outermost is the deadlock over tribute and the frontier: Lâm Ấp had kept up intercourse with the Chinese court since the Kaihuang reign, but the king Fan Zhi neither came to court at the appointed time nor gave up what he held in the Yuè Shàng region, so the standing of the two states and the line between them were both unsettled, and the Sui advance south amounted to forcing him to declare himself. The second layer is the Sui policy in the South Sea: the fashion at court of officials speaking of the abundance of rare treasures in Lâm Ấp had long been there, the Sui had already set up the counties of Bi Cang and Hai Yin and had sent the colony superintendent Chang Jun by sea to the country of Chitu, and the territory of Lâm Ấp was treated at court as a dependency to be administered; and after three campaigns against Koguryŏ had ended in defeat in the Daye years, Emperor Yang needed a victory in the south to restore his authority. The third layer is the maturity of the military means: with Jiaozhou and Xuanzhou already pacified, the Sui could levy men and grain and take in the southern clans, the navy and the sea transport had been usable since the southern dynasties, and the court believed it had the measure of the job. The real flaw lay there too. The eastern capital, the canals, the wall and the repeated wars in the north had drained the dynasty to the last drop, and an expedition of a hundred thousand men had to be fed by sea and sustained along a supply chain through tropical hills, and there was no strength of the people left to bear that cost. From the beginning this war was therefore not only a matter of diplomacy but a wager made by a dying dynasty with the last of its strength.
impact: 這場敗仗的第一重影響在國際格局上：林邑沒有被征服，杜揚州只是一紙羈縻之名，占婆王國完好地延續了下去，並在此後數百年成為南海強國，與真臘、室利佛逝爭衡，直到唐至德年間國號改稱環王。第二重影響在隋朝內部：大業十二年已是隋朝崩潰前的最後一年，翌年楊玄感在黎陽起兵，天下群雄並起；諸將因敗績被治罪的消息傳回京師，與連年大役的疲敝疊在一起，把最後一點軍心與民力耗盡。第三重影響在對南海秩序的長期安排：隋朝在林邑故地置杜揚州，唐代改置驩州並與占城通使往來，這一套以郡縣羈縻加海上貿易的框架，就是隋唐時期南海經營的雛形；漢晉以來南疆無序的狀態，自此被納入中原王朝的視野。第四重影響在軍事學上：這場戰役把遠征熱帶的兩大死因暴露得一清二楚——不是戰死，而是疾疫與斷糧；同時也證明攻城必須有完整的器械、內應與封鎖，單靠人海與士氣，連數月都撐不住。而這一點，羅馬人用方陣盾的故事講過另一面：盾牆保得住正面，卻從來擋不住從內部或側面崩塌的隊形。
impactEn: The first effect of this defeat lay in the international situation: Lâm Ấp was not conquered, Duyang Zhou was a nominal act of containment, and the Cham kingdom went on to exist, becoming a power of the South Sea over the following centuries, contending with Zhèn Là and with Srivijaya, and keeping its own name of Huán Wáng only from the Zhide era of the Tang. The second effect lay inside the Sui: the twelfth year of Daye was the last full year of the dynasty, in the following year Yang Xuansheng rose at Liyang and the various claimants of the realm took their separate paths, and the news that the generals had been punished for the failure came back to the capital and was laid on top of the exhaustion of years of war, so that the last of the morale and the strength of the people was spent. The third effect lay in the long arrangement of order in the South Sea: the Sui set up Duyang Zhou in the old Lâm Ấp territory, the Tang replaced it with Xuanzhou and corresponded with the Cham, and the framework of containment by commandery coupled with trade across the sea that we see in the Sui and the Tang was shaped here; the disorder of the southern frontier since the Han and the Jin was from then on brought within the view of the Chinese dynasties. The fourth effect lies in the military lesson: this campaign laid bare the two great killers of a distant expedition in the tropics, which were not the enemy but sickness and the broken supply line, and it showed that taking a city requires a full set of siege equipment, a way in from inside and a blockade, and that neither numbers nor courage would hold a city for even a few months. The Romans told the other half of that story with the scutum: a shield-wall can hold the front, but it can never hold a formation that collapses from within or from the side.
result: 結果是隋軍第二次攻林邑的徹底失敗：劉方大軍自交州深入，糧盡疫生，抵達毗驩後圍城數月不能下；國相昆吾以詐降為名誘使隋軍入城，隨即反戈，奪門縱火，隋軍前鋒崩潰，潰兵在城外被象群與毒箭追殺，劉方中箭卒於軍中，士卒死者甚眾，諸軍無功而還，還朝之後諸將多被治罪。隋朝卻仍舊在林邑故地置杜揚州，以驩州為州治，把這次打不通的地方掛上一個州的名；林邑國王梵志遣使請罪、貢奉不絕，國祚無恙，直到唐武德五年杜揚州被廢、改置驩州。回到卡面這件羅馬方陣盾：它不在毗驩城下，羅馬盾手的經驗也無法直接套用到南海，但它的道理仍然成立——盾牆的力量來自整體咬合與秩序維持，而隋軍這一次敗在進攻過深、糧道斷裂，以及輕信一紙詐降。盾擋得住箭，擋不住飢餓、疲疫與謊言。
resultEn: The result was the thorough defeat of the second Sui attack on Lâm Ấp. Liu Fang's army came deep into the country from Jiaozhou, ran out of grain and was worn down by sickness, and after reaching Viadhapura could not take the city in several months of siege. The minister Kun Wu, under the pretence of surrender, drew part of the Sui army into the city, and then turned his weapons, seized the gates and set fire; the Sui advance guard collapsed, the broken troops were run down outside the walls by the elephants and the poisoned arrows, Liu Fang was killed by a shaft in the camp, very many of the soldiers were dead, the armies returned having achieved nothing, and on their return to court several of the generals were punished. The Sui nevertheless set up Duyang Zhou in the old Lâm Ấp territory, with Xuanzhou as its seat, hanging the name of a prefecture on a place it could not reach; the king Fan Zhi sent an embassy to apologise and his tribute continued, the state was unharmed, and Duyang Zhou was abolished in the fifth year of Wude when the Tang set up Xuanzhou in its place. Back to the weapon on the card: the scutum was not at Viadhapura, and the experience of the Roman shieldman could not be applied directly on the South Sea, but the principle of it holds. The strength of a shield-wall comes from the interlocking of the whole and from the maintenance of order, and the Sui army this time lost because it had gone in too deep, because its supply line was broken, and because it believed a feigned surrender. A shield keeps the arrows out; it does not keep out hunger, pestilence and lies.
